title: Implementation Engineer (Remote)
description:
***when applying for roles at tealium, please use our official careers page or linkedin company profile. all other sites where tealium careers may appear may not be legitimate.***

**who we are**

tealium is the trusted leader in real\-time **customer data platforms (cdp)** , helping organizations unify their customer data to deliver more personalized, privacy\-conscious experiences. as the demand for connected, intelligent customer engagement grows, tealium’s leadership in cdp is translating directly into leadership in **enabling enterprise ai strategies** . by providing clean, consented, and actionable data, tealium empowers its customers to accelerate the adoption of ai and machine learning, fueling smarter personalization, predictive insights, and business outcomes at scale.


more than 800 leading global brands trust tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real\-time, personalized experiences at scale.


team tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. we win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. we are intentional about our wows (ways of work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect.


with an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including georgian, silver lake waterman, battery, and others) and deep industry experience, tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. today, tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:


* a leader in the 2025 gartner® magic quadrant™ for customer data platforms
* 2025 trustradius award winner: buyer’s choice
* 2024 invoca partner collaboration award
* 2024 g2 leader in tag management \& enterprise data governance
* tealium customer data hub achieved the top rated award by trustradius (2024\)
* named on destination crm’s 2024 top 100 technologies list for sales
* named on the 2024 best and brightest in the nation list
* builtin’s 2024 best place to work

  

**what we are looking for**

  

we are looking for an implementation engineer to join our field engineering organization. the implementation engineer (ie) is a customer\-facing technical partner who works closely with account teams and customers to drive successful implementations, accelerate platform adoption, and ensure measurable outcomes across the customer lifecycle.  



  

this role goes beyond traditional implementation delivery. it requires a blend of technical consulting, solution design, customer data strategy, and data analysis to support complex customer environments. the ie serves as a trusted advisor, helping customers solve technical challenges, optimize their platform use, and realize sustained business value through proactive engagement and guidance.  



  

we’re placing greater emphasis on individuals who can think strategically, operate independently, leverage ai and modern tools effectively, and drive efficient outcomes. successful candidates will demonstrate strong ownership, resourcefulness, data\-driven decision\-making, adaptability, continuous learning, and a highly collaborative mindset across internal and external stakeholders.


this role also requires the ability to effectively leverage ai\-powered tools and modern workflows to accelerate implementation delivery, improve data quality and troubleshooting, and enhance customer outcomes at scale.  



  

**your day to day**

  

* proactively support customer adoption, expansion, and technical success across proof of value, implementation, and forward\-deployed engagements.
* collaborate with customers, account teams, and partners to design and implement end\-to\-end solutions that connect data collection, enrichment, activation, and measurement to clear business and ai\-driven outcomes
* lead discovery and solutioning sessions to clarify goals, validate feasibility, assess customer architectures and implementation maturity, and identify technical risks, adoption blockers, optimization opportunities, and new use cases.
* serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts across data, marketing, it, and emerging ai\-focused use cases in a clear and actionable way
* leverage ai tools and modern workflows (including code assistants, automation, and analytics copilots) to accelerate implementation delivery, improve solution quality, and surface insights more efficiently
* use sql, data analysis, visualization, and ai\-assisted analytics to validate data quality, identify patterns, and generate scalable, customer\-ready insights and recommendations
* troubleshoot complex technical issues across javascript tags, apis, sdks, integrations, and data pipelines, using both traditional debugging methods and ai\-assisted diagnostic approaches to accelerate resolution
* support proof of value and expansion opportunities by identifying technical requirements, validating solution fit, documenting key decisions and next steps, and applying deep expertise in tealium’s solutions across customer engagements.
* identify, evaluate, and implement ai\-enabled and modern tooling opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, reduce manual effort, accelerate time\-to\-value, and optimize delivery outcomes at scale.
act as a bridge between technical execution and business outcomes, ensuring every implementation is tied to measurable customer value and long\-term success  
* 

  

**what you bring to tealium**  



* experience working with tealium products and solutions is strongly preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience in client\-facing technical roles such as implementation, solutions consulting, technical support, or customer\-facing engineering within a saas, digital technology, martech, or data environment.
* strong experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to tagging, apis, sdks, integrations, data discrepancies, and front\-end implementations in complex customer environments
* deep familiarity with digital marketing technologies, tag management, customer data platforms, digital analytics, and data/ai\-driven workflows across web, mobile, and connected applications
* demonstrated ability to leverage ai\-powered tools and modern workflows (e.g., code assistants, analytics copilots, automation tools) to accelerate debugging, improve solution quality, and increase delivery efficiency
* strong written and verbal communication skills in english are required; spanish language proficiency is a plus.
* proficiency with sql and data analysis to validate implementations, assess data quality, identify issues, and generate actionable customer insights and recommendations
* expert in javascript, html, css, python, js frameworks, and experience in mobile frameworks or other coding languages.
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* ability to lead customer\-facing discussions, manage expectations, navigate escalated issues, and collaborate effectively across internal teams, partners, and customers.
* demonstrated ownership mentality with the ability to independently manage customer expectations, drive issue resolution, and execute without heavy reliance on program or project management support.
* data\-driven mindset with the ability to make decisions grounded in analysis, measurement, and customer impact
* continuous learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, especially ai\-enabled tooling and modern implementation practice.
ability and willingness to travel approximately 20% to support customer engagements, onsite meetings, and other business needs.  
*

title: Sr Business Analyst, Applied Intelligence
description:
founded in 1977 as the senior care action network, scan began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. that belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 angry seniors.” their mission continues to guide everything we do.


today, scan is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across arizona, california, nevada, new mexico, texas, and washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. with nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


our work spans medicare advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


at scan, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. we are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**the job**

  

the senior business analyst serves as the critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams (development, data science, data warehouse and infrastructure) by translating prioritized business needs into detailed technical and data requirements for proposed analytic solutions. the individual acts as a trusted advisor to technical delivery teams, applying back\-end data knowledge to ensure requirements are complete, feasible, and buildable, surfacing data quality, structure, and integration considerations early enough to prevent rework. this role is dedicated to supporting our operations (e.g., claim adjudication, payment integrity), experience (e.g., member call center, digital and member portal teams, member experience), and commercial (e.g., sales, marketing) teams, developing the domain depth in each area needed to translate business needs into technical designs that reflect how these teams' data and processes actually work. the senior business analyst shapes business use cases into the detailed specifications, data mappings, and technical designs that delivery teams need to execute.

 **you will**

* partners with business stakeholders, particularly in the member experience, operations and commercial functions to solve complex business problems by designing custom data and analytics solutions to support informed decision\-making in pursuit of critical outcomes for scan
* interprets and develops business requests into well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria, using sound business acumen and deep understanding of data and technical platforms within the context of the operating environment.
* collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate ai\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy.
* responsible for exploratory data analysis, as well as creation of wireframes, mock\-ups, and proofs of concept to ensure the scope of work presented to delivery teams will meet the needs of the business.
* develop and maintain actionable hybrid functional design documents (fdds)/technical design documents (tdds), and user stories to support solution delivery, while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, define business rules, and facilitate issue resolution throughout the development lifecycle.
* collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate ai\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy
* leads user acceptance testing (uat) along with business users against documented acceptance criteria and exercises judgement in considering modifications or enhancements that should be incorporated in the current development cycle.
* continuously expands expertise in business processes, applications, data domains, and industry practices to support effective requirements analysis, solution design, and stakeholder engagement.
* provides thought leadership and promotes best practices to deliver effective, user\-friendly and sustainable solutions.
* apply advanced analytic techniques to solve business problems and address needs.
* we seek rebels who are curious about ai and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* actively support the achievement of scan’s vision and goals.
* other duties as assigned.

 **your qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in business, statistics, analytics, or technology related discipline or equivalent experience
* comfortable interviewing and presenting to all levels of management.
* experienced in creating best\-in\-class solutions with bi tools (e.g., power bi, tableau, ssrs) with demonstrated ability to design effective and easy to use interfaces for a wide range of personas.
* knowledge of operations and data utilized in medicare advantage or other managed care models, with emphasis on claims, coding, membership and experience datasets
* strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and familiarity with cloud platforms (microsoft azure, amazon web services (aws), google cloud platform (gcp), snowflake, databricks).
* experience with querying and manipulating data structures in on\-premises or cloud data warehouses (sql, snowflake, databricks, ssis).
* familiarity with ai tools and techniques, machine learning, data science, and advanced statistical techniques and concepts.
* able to work in a scaled agile framework.
* experienced working with both onshore and offshore development teams.
* understanding of health plan strategic objectives, especially around member experience
* ability to translate vague business questions into structured analytical problems, and work with technical colleagues to architect and deliver solutions
* proficient in mapping existing workflows and identifying pain points or inefficiencies
* facilitates stakeholder interviews, requirement\-gathering workshops, and sprint planning
* manages a backlog of competing priorities and aligns analytics deliverables with business value
* sql proficiency for querying and validating data (snowflake, sql server, etc.).
* familiarity with data visualization tools such as power bi, tableau, or ssrs
* understanding of data models and ability to collaborate with data engineers (e.g., star schema, data marts).
* conducts detailed interviews to elicit and document business needs
* writes clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and use cases
* understands the lifecycle of analytic product development (from ideation to delivery)
* participates in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and uat testing; tracks progress in tools like azure devops / jira
* appreciates importance of data quality, privacy, and stewardship
* works with data governance teams to align analytics with master data management, security, and compliance
* comfortable shifting between strategic and tactical work, or across domains (e.g., member experience, commercial, operations).

 **what's in it for you?**

* base salary range: $106,200 to $182,983 annually
* an annual employee bonus program
* robust wellness program
* generous paid\-time\-off (pto)
* 11 paid holidays per year, 1 floating holiday, birthday off, and 2 volunteer days
* excellent 401(k) retirement saving plan with employer match
* robust employee recognition program
* tuition reimbursement
* an opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

  

we're always looking for talented people to join our team! qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

  

at scan we believe that it is our business to improve the state of our world. each of us has a responsibility to drive equality in our communities and workplaces. we are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

  

scan is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. individuals seeking employment will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. a background check is required.

title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
description:
job id: 112338



* atlanta

* chicago
* dallas
* new york city
* san francisco
* washington dc

do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **you’ve come to the right place.**
**your impact**
---------------


you will work as a core member of a multidisciplinary team to build and deliver advanced analytics and ai solutions that address complex business challenges across industries. you’ll contribute to analytical workstreams, learn from experienced data scientists and engineers, and build your expertise across a breadth of industries and technologies.
*this full\-time opportunity is for current students with an upcoming graduation between december 2026 and august 2027 with a master's, bachelor's or phd in computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field.*
you will translate business challenges into analytical problems and develop and evaluate solutions across machine learning, optimization, genai, and agentic ai systems. with guidance from more experienced colleagues, you’ll contribute to selecting and implementing analytical approaches, and ensure your work meets rigorous standards for data quality and evaluation. as you develop, you’ll take on increasing ownership for delivering solutions that are robust and fit for purpose.
your work will create measurable impact on some of the most complex challenges facing organizations today. collaborating across quantumblack, ai by mckinsey and quantumblack labs teams, you’ll help clients harness advanced analytics and ai to improve decisions, transform operations, and build new capabilities. here’s how you might contribute over a given year:
* develop an agentic ai solution that automates complex claims workflows for a global insurance company
* optimize the schedule and funding of a multi\-billion\-dollar capital project to accelerate delivery
* leverage predictive modeling and agentic ai to improve customer service outcomes for a global travel company
* build a digital twin of an automotive supply chain to enhance product availability
you'll be based in one of our north america offices as part of our global data science community. working in cross\-functional teams, you’ll collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, and industry experts, and work with clients across technical and business teams. through these experiences, you’ll build your ability to connect analytical work with business needs and develop your skills as a client\-facing technologist.
your work offers a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of ai and data science. you’ll build expertise at the intersection of technology and business, develop your understanding of how ai solutions move from problem definition through development, evaluation, and implementation, and learn alongside leading technologists and ai practitioners.
**your growth**
---------------


driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. you are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
in return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
when you join us, you will have:

title: Senior Software Engineer (West Coast USA)
description:
**about misumi americas**


misumi americas, a division of misumi group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. by integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, misumi americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. with operations in the san francisco bay area and chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the americas.


**senior software engineer**
============================


**location:** remote (west coast usa)


**company:** misumi americas


**please note: final\-round interviews will be conducted in person in either oakland, california, or portland, oregon.**


**build the future of manufacturing**
-------------------------------------


manufacturing is a $13 trillion industry, and most of it is still held together by spreadsheets, phone calls, and fax machines. misumi americas is rewriting that.


we've been building a cloud\-based, ai\-powered digital manufacturing platform that takes companies from prototype to production faster than the industry thought possible. our platform pairs intelligent software with a global network of vetted manufacturing partners, powering innovation across electric vehicles, robotics, and next\-generation consumer products.


we're scaling fast, and we're looking for engineers who'd rather untangle hard, real\-world problems than push pixels on a toy app.


you'll join the team that owns costing, pricing, lead time, and dfm (design for manufacturability) for our instant quoting platform. when a customer uploads a part, our systems decide what it costs, when it ships, and whether it can be made. accuracy matters; our output directly drives revenue and customer trust.


we build with ai agents as a core part of how we work. we're looking for strong engineers who use agents to plan, implement, and test faster, and who have the judgment to know when the output is wrong.


**what you'll do**
------------------


as a senior backend engineer, you'll help build and scale the systems running our global manufacturing ecosystem:


* design and develop highly available, scalable backend services in aws
* build and maintain event\-driven, asynchronous systems using node.js
* create robust apis (rest / graphql) powering customer\-facing and internal tools
* use ai coding agents to take features from design through implementation and testing, while owning the correctness of every change
* write specs, tests, and repo context that make agent\-driven development reliable in a large, established codebase
* partner closely with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to ship features that actually move the business
* contribute to technical design discussions and drive best practices across the team
* help shape how the team works with ai: sharing patterns, tooling, and lessons learned
* debug production issues and improve system reliability
* continuously improve code quality through testing, observability, and documentation

**what you bring**
------------------


* 5 \+ years of backend engineering experience
* strong skills in node.js, javascript/typescript
* experience building systems on aws (sqs, lambda, ec2, rds, etc.)
* solid understanding of distributed systems and event\-driven architectures
* experience designing and maintaining rest or graphql apis
* familiarity with sql and nosql databases
* a commitment to writing unit and integration tests
* knowledge of system design, caching, and security best practices (owasp top 10\)
* hands\-on experience shipping production code with ai coding agents (e.g., claude code, cursor, copilot agent mode), with clear examples of where you had to step in, correct, or override them
* strong code review skills, applied just as rigorously to ai\-generated changes
* **must be a u.s. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder)**

**nice to have:**


* aws certification
* experience with high\-scale or business\-critical systems
* experience with pricing, quoting, or other numerically sensitive business logic
* experience building agent workflows, custom tools, or mcp integrations for your team

**how you work**
----------------


* you take ownership and ship clean, maintainable, production\-ready code
* you treat ai as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding the system
* you communicate clearly and collaborate across teams
* you solve problems proactively, even outside your immediate scope
* you enjoy mentoring others and raising the bar for engineering excellence
* you stay curious and keep learning new technologies and patterns

**why misumi americas?**
------------------------


* work on real\-world problems impacting global supply chains
* join a fast\-growing company at the intersection of ai, software, and manufacturing
* collaborate with teams building products used by top hardware innovators
* competitive compensation and benefits
* flexible, west coast\-friendly work environment
* minimal travel (0–10%)

**ready to build something that matters?**
------------------------------------------


if scaling systems, solving hard problems, and shaping the future of manufacturing sounds like your kind of work, we want to hear from you.


**salary range:** $160,000 – $200,000 per year, depending on experience


we’re actively seeking teammates who:


* bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

we encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the lgbtq community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

colgate\-palmolive company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in oral care, personal care, home care, skin care, and pet nutrition. our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

we are looking for a highly motivated senior platform engineer to design, build, and continually modernize our internal development platform using gcp native technologies and kubernetes. this individual will partner directly with the existing lead senior platform engineer to co\-drive the platform strategy, foster innovation, and lead agentic software development initiatives. this role bridges the gap between our development teams and the underlying infrastructure, enabling teams to build fast, reliable, secure, and standardized software. you will provide strategic leadership and high\-level architectural oversight, empowering developers by building automated "golden paths" and self\-service tools that abstract away infrastructure complexities and reduce cognitive load.  

you will serve as a member of our open source program office, acting as the internal expert to build out our open source strategy and support teams on open source software adoption and processes.  

**responsibilities:**
* **strategic leadership \& partnership:** partner with engineering leadership to define and execute the long\-term platform roadmap. drive collaborative decision\-making across the organization, influencing technical strategy and ensuring high\-level architectural alignment with business goals.

* **agentic software \& platform development:** lead and drive the development of team\-owned platforms, including building intelligent agents for internal architecture and security review processes. design and support advanced cloud management platforms that leverage agentic workflows to enhance organizational efficiency and security posture.
* **kubernetes maintenance \& troubleshooting:** manage and maintain our kubernetes instances and containerized workloads. provide hands\-on incident management, debugging, and troubleshooting to assist teams and quickly resolve complex system issues.
* **open source program management:** define, implement, and communicate our internal and external open source strategy, policies, and management processes. serve as the resident expert to support multi\-functional teams on open source software tooling, dependency management, and best practices.

* **collaboration \& knowledge sharing:** work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand their needs, create detailed technical documentation, and lead knowledge\-sharing or training sessions to reduce tribal knowledge.

**required qualifications:**
* 6\+ years of experience in a software engineering or platform engineering role.
* completed bachelors degree

**preferred qualifications:**  

  

* proficiency in low\-level coding and scripting languages (e.g., python, javascript(reactjs)) for building automations and debugging complex systems.

* experience with monitoring, observability, and logging tools (such as sentry, datadog, grafana, or elk) to proactively identify issues before they impact service.

title: Senior Data Scientist Online & Marketing
description:
position purpose:  


the sr. data scientist is responsible for leading data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. this role assists in the development of the home depot advanced analytics infrastructure that informs decision making. sr. data scientists are expected to seek out business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage. based on the specific data science team, this role would need to be proficient in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or nlp.  
as a sr. data scientist, you will serve as a lead on data science projects, collaborating with project/product managers, providing prioritization of tasks, balancing workload and mentoring data scientists on the project team. this role is expected to present insights and recommendations to leaders and business partners and explain the benefits and impacts of the recommended solutions. this role supports the building of skilled and talented data science teams by providing input to staffing needs and participating in the recruiting and hiring process. in addition, data scientists collaborate with business partners and cross\-functional teams, requiring effective communication skills, building relationships and partnerships, and leveraging business proficiency to solutions and recommendations.  


key responsibilities:  
35% solution development \- proficiently design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies; effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical leaders and business customers/partners; prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution; clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation  
30% project management \& team support \- work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals; provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team  
20% business collaboration \- leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross\-functional teams; provide general education on advanced analytics to technical and non\-technical business partners; deep understanding of it needs for the team to be successful in tackling business problems; actively seek out new business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage  
15% technical exploration \& development \- seek further knowledge on key developments within data science, technical skill sets, and additional data sources; participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented

this position reports to manager or above  
this position has 0 direct reports

typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. on rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.  


working conditions:  
located in a comfortable indoor area. any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.  


minimum qualifications:  
must be eighteen years of age or older.  
must be legally permitted to work in the united states.

phd in a quantitative field (computer science, math, statistics, etc.)  
6\+ years of experience in business intelligence and analytics  
working knowledge of microsoft excel and power point  
proficient in a modern scripting language (preferably python)  
proficient running queries against data (preferably with google bigquery or sql)  
proficient with data visualization software (preferably tableau)  
mastery utilizing statistical techniques to identify key insights that help solve business problems  
proficient in prescriptive modeling like optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or nlp  
demonstrated proficiency in predictive modeling, data mining and data analysis

the knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.  


preferred education:  
no additional education

5  


preferred years of work experience:  
no additional years of experience

none  


preferred leadership experience:  
none  


certifications:  
none

title: Senior STIBO Software Developer
description:
we’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. at cvs health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**position summary**


cvs health digital is looking for hands\-on, passionate people who want to join a high energy and growing team to make a difference in customers’ lives and who want to be on the forefront of digital innovation that aims to reinvent what a pharmacy and a health care company can be in the digital world. currently, we are hiring for an experienced senior stibo software developer to support enterprise master data management (mdm) initiatives in a fast\-paced retail and healthcare environment. this senior developer focuses on building scalable data solutions to manage product, vendor, and customer master data across omnichannel systems while ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency.

 *expectations for the role:*

* invest 15% of your time mentoring less experienced engineers
* invest 15% of your efforts working alongside product as well as stakeholders on other teams
* invest 70% of your time using your technical sme and coding skills in strategic planning, scoping, delivery, and working alongside the senior engineering manager
* develop and support stibo step solutions, workflows, and integrations
* ensure data quality, governance, and platform performance
* troubleshoot and resolve complex platform and data issues
* drive delivery through accurate estimates, ownership, and communication
* support production operations, saas upgrades, and continuous improvements
* design, develop, configure and customize the stibo step platform, including workflows, webui interfaces, attributes and validation rules
* support quarterly saas upgrades and release impact reviews
* implement data governance, stewardship, and data quality frameworks
* optimize platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide production support

 **required qualifications**

* 5\+ years of mdm/pim development experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on stibo step development and administration experience
* 3\+ years of experience with ci/cd tools including azure devops, jenkins and git
* 3\+ years of experience with azure (preferred) or gcp cloud platforms

 **preferred qualifications**

* experience with rest/soap apis, xml, json, kafka and informatica
* retail or healthcare industry experience
* knowledge of product lifecycle and catalog management
* experience supporting omnichannel retail environments
* knowledge of supplier/vendor onboarding and healthcare regulatory data handling
* experience using ai for data maintenance in step
* strong knowledge of javascript, web ui development, sql and data modeling
* ability to drive master data governance and product/vendor lifecycle management
* strong collaboration and problem\-solving skills

 **education**


bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (hs diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience)

 **business overview**


bring your heart to cvs health every one of us at cvs health shares a single, clear purpose: bringing our heart to every moment of your health. this purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. our heart at work behaviors™ support this purpose. we want everyone who works at cvs health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. we strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. cvs health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which cvs health provides management services. we do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. we proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and national guard) as well as military spouses to apply for cvs health job opportunities.

40**time type**


full time**pay range**


the typical pay range for this role is:


$83,430\.00 \- $222,480\.00

title: Software Engineer
description:
optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. the work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. join us to start **caring. connecting. growing together.**


we are seeking a **sr. software engineer** to join our optum umr clinical technology team as an etl developer. in this role, you will play a critical part in the end\-to\-end (e2e) solution design, code development, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing production support to resolve complex system issues. this position is ideal for an engineer who possesses a strong backend data background combined with extensive experience in resolving database issues and providing high\-level production support. working within our clinical reporting platform ecosystem, you will design robust clinical systems, resolve production issues, and drive the adoption of approved ai tools throughout all phases of the software development life cycle (sdlc) to deliver high\-quality, automated workflows safely and responsibly.


you will enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the u.s. as you take on some tough challenges.

**primary responsibilities:**

* analyze business requirements to design, develop, and deliver e2e software and data integration solutions for clinical datawarehouse and reporting platform systems
* resolve complex technical issues and provide comprehensive production support to maintain system availability, stability, and optimal clinical application performance
* drive the adoption and integration of approved ai tools throughout all phases of the software development life cycle (sdlc) to streamline requirements analysis, design, code development, automated testing, and deployment
* design, develop, and deploy ai\-powered tools and data\-processing features to optimize pipelines, improve data quality, and automate workflows with an emphasis on responsible ai usage
* provide dedicated support for clinical application service availability, stability, and system performance, including supporting production environments off\-hours and providing on\-call support when needed
* resolve complex production issues within service level agreements (slas) by debugging code, analyzing logs, and performing reverse engineering to determine root causes and implement permanent fixes
* manage code reviews and migrations through various deployment environments and stages for clinical platform releases
* establish repeatable processes, software engineering best practices, version control, automated testing, and continuous deployment workflows
* evaluate emerging technology and ai/ml trends to inform robust, reliable clinical data architecture and strategic platform innovation


you'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**required qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience providing production operational support and resolving issues for high\-availability enterprise systems
* 4\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on sql, oracle databases, pl/sql development, and unix scripting
* 3\+ years of experience building, integrating, or deploying applications utilizing aiml solutions, snowflake, apis, including ai‑driven automation or ai personas
* 3\+ years of experience with github, ci/cd pipelines, code reviews, and devops best practices
* 3\+ years of experience with kafka for event‑driven or streaming architectures
* 3\+ years of data engineering experience with snowflake and relational databases
* 2\+ years prior experience or hands\-on knowledge working with apache airflow and twsd (tivoli workload scheduler) batch jobs

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, engineering, or a related technology field
* experience working in the healthcare industry, specifically with clinical systems and reporting platforms
* experience with agile, scrum, and kanban principles and associated tools (e.g., rally, jira)
* experience implementing modern automated testing, ci/cd pipeline structures (e.g., jenkins, gitlab), and version control best practices (e.g., git)
* experience building and supporting restful apis and distributed systems
* proficiency with java, .net, react ui and modern front‑end development practices
* all telecommuters will be required to adhere to unitedhealth group's telecommuter policy.

  



pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. in addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). no matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. the salary for this role will range from $72,800 to $130,000 annually based on full\-time employment. we comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

title: Intern, Applied AI (2027)
description:
**we make life more rewarding and dignified**


**location**: libertyville
  

**department**: information technology

  

**position summary**
  

join the data \& ai team as an applied ai intern and contribute to real\-world enterprise ai solutions. you will help design, build, test, and improve generative ai agents, knowledge assistants, retrieval solutions, and intelligent workflows that support business, r\&d, quality, and enterprise operations. the role combines hands\-on solution development with applied research, evaluation, documentation, and responsible ai practices.


this internship is designed for talented undergraduate and master’s candidates who are eager to apply ai, software engineering, and analytical skills in a collaborative corporate environment. the intern will work closely with ai architects, engineers, it specialists, and business stakeholders while learning how ai solutions move from business need and prototype to governed enterprise deployment.


hollister incorporated operates in a hybrid environment, interns are required to come into the office in libertyville illinois a minimum of 4 days per week. hollister does not provide relocation nor housing assistancefor this opportunity.


**responsibilities**
====================


* **contribute to ai agent development:** assist with the design, configuration, development, and testing of enterprise ai agents and copilots using microsoft copilot studio, azure ai technologies, python, apis, and related tools.
* **build knowledge and retrieval solutions:** support retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), knowledge graph, enterprise search, document intelligence, semantic and vector search, metadata filtering, citations, and grounded response patterns across structured and unstructured information.
* **evaluate and improve ai quality:** create and execute evaluation scenarios; assess accuracy, relevance, grounding, citations, retrieval quality, response consistency, and usability; document defects and recommend improvements.
* **analyze enterprise content:** review sharepoint sites, documents, pdfs, spreadsheets, images, and other knowledge sources for ai readiness. help identify ocr, content\-quality, metadata, access, and indexing requirements.
* **prototype ai solutions:** conduct focused research on emerging ai models, frameworks, apis, orchestration approaches, and platform capabilities. build small proof\-of\-concepts to assess technical feasibility and business value.
* **support api and system integration:** help connect ai agents with enterprise services, custom connectors, apis, azure functions, data platforms, and business applications under the guidance of senior team members.
* **apply responsible ai and security practices:** follow organizational requirements for data protection, privacy, security, access control, human review, source grounding, and responsible use of ai. avoid exposing credentials, sensitive information, or unsupported claims.
* **use collaborative development practices:** work with github, source control, branching, pull requests, documentation, and deployment pipelines to support collaboration, traceability, and recoverability of ai solutions.
* **collaborate across functions:** participate in requirements discussions, demonstrations, working sessions, and testing with it, r\&d, quality, data, automation, and business teams.
* **document and present results:** maintain clear technical notes, solution documentation, test evidence, project updates, and implementation guidance. present project outcomes and recommendations at the end of the internship.

**potential project exposure**
==============================


* enterprise knowledge agents and business\-facing copilots, including competitive intelligence, market access, finance, and r\&d knowledge assistants.
* quality document intelligence initiatives involving document search, comparison, metadata, product drawings, dhf/dmr analysis, traceability, and compliance\-oriented workflows.
* reusable ai\-agent evaluation frameworks for regression testing, quality measurement, and release validation.
* enterprise ai platform capabilities such as retrieval services, agent orchestration, knowledge graphs, context engineering, observability, governance, and reusable development standards.
* digital twin and simulation\-related ai experiences, including data preparation, result analysis, workflow automation, and user interaction improvements.
* ai knowledge\-source preparation, ocr assessment, sharepoint integration, github collaboration, and ci/cd practices for ai solutions.

**requirements**
================


* **education:** currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a related field. candidate should remain enrolled in an academic program after the internship.
* **ai and software fundamentals:** foundational understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative ai, large language models, software development, data structures, databases, or apis through coursework or projects.
* **programming skills:** experience with at least one programming language used for data or application development, preferably c\# or python. ability to write understandable, maintainable code and troubleshoot technical issues.
* **communication skills:** strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **collaboration and learning:** curiosity, initiative, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-moving environment.

**preferred skills (bonus)**
============================


* hands\-on experience with generative ai, prompt engineering, ai agents, chatbots, rag, embeddings, semantic search, or vector databases.
* exposure microsoft copilot studio, microsoft azure, azure ai search, azure ai foundry, microsoft fabric, power platform, or sharepoint.
* experience using rest apis, json, git, github, ci/cd pipelines, or cloud development environments.
* familiarity with python libraries for data analysis, machine learning, or ai application development.
* experience designing test cases or evaluating ai/ml systems for accuracy, reliability, or responsible use.
* awareness of ai ethics, privacy, security, governance, and the importance of human oversight in enterprise or regulated environments.
* previous internship, research, hackathon, or substantial academic project involving ai, data, automation, or software development.

**what you will learn**
=======================


* how enterprise generative ai solutions are identified, designed, built, tested, governed, deployed, and improved.
* how agents use trusted enterprise data, retrieval, apis, citations, and controls to produce grounded responses.
* how to evaluate ai quality systematically and use evidence to improve prompts, knowledge sources, tools, and workflows.
* how multidisciplinary teams collaborate to deliver ai solutions in a secure, responsible, and scalable manner.
* how modern engineering practices, documentation, source control, and release processes support production ai delivery.

**location**
============


**libertyville, illinois, usa** – this internship is based at the libertyville office and requires regular in\-person collaboration with the team during summer 2027\. specific hybrid\-work expectations will be confirmed during the recruiting process. relocation assistance, housing, and transportation are not provided for this opportunity.

**devops engineer ii**
======================


sovos·full\-time·united states

the digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. governments now have real\-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. at sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through ai\-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real\-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.


we're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. we're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.


ai is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. that's where sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.


don't worry if you don't check every box. we're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. it's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
**the role**


at sovos, we're building infrastructure that powers global tax compliance at scale. as a devops engineer ii, you'll manage and scale cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines that keep our systems reliable, efficient, and always evolving. you'll work at the intersection of development and operations to automate, optimize, and solve problems that directly impact how we deliver software to customers around the world.


*more specifically, you will:*


* build and manage auto\-scalable docker swarm or kubernetes clusters using terraform for infrastructure as code, leveraging ai\-assisted tools to accelerate provisioning and troubleshooting.

* develop deployment scripts, health checks, alerts, and automation workflows that keep infrastructure and applications running smoothly.
* manage configuration and settings for applications and infrastructure, ensuring consistency and reliability across environments.
* collaborate with product, engineering, and operations teams to streamline deployment processes and resolve release\-related issues efficiently.
* document technical processes, configurations, and deployment workflows to enable knowledge sharing and onboarding.
**what you bring to sovos**


* you've built solid hands\-on experience with azure devops, docker swarm or kubernetes, and terraform in production environments.
* you're comfortable scripting and automating tasks using languages like bash, powershell, or python.
* you understand ci/cd principles and have created or maintained deployment pipelines that deliver software reliably and frequently.
* you're a skilled problem\-solver who can troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues when issues arise.
* you have experience with cloud platforms, particularly azure, and understand how to design for scalability and resilience.
* you're comfortable working with ai\-assisted workflows and tools that help accelerate infrastructure management and automation.
* due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check and drug test upon hire.

a chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. our flagship product, the sovos compliance cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150\+ countries.

title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales)
description:
new york, us · full\-time · senior
#### **about the position**


**about coralogix**


coralogix is a full\-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real\-time visibility at scale.


our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. with a no\-index architecture and in\-stream analytics, coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance.


we are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real\-world environments.

 **this is a fully remote position, but candidates must be located in new york state or new jersey.**

 **the role**


we are hiring a solutions engineer to join our east\-coast pre\-sales team.


this is a senior, hands\-on technical sales role. you will partner with account executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate coralogix in their own environments.


during evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. you will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate coralogix across their environment. you need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value.


this role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations and help drive deals to a strong technical close.

 **what you’ll do**

* own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with account executives.
* lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria.
* design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect coralogix to real customer use cases.
* manage technical evaluations and pocs from scope through validation.
* support hands\-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations.
* work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases.
* explain coralogix’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision.
* partner with product, engineering, customer success, and support to represent field feedback and improve how we win.


#### **requirements**


* 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, pre\-sales, solution architecture, technical consulting, devops, sre, platform engineering, or security engineering.
* strong hands\-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work.
* solid understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, apm, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring.
* experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept processes.
* ability to speak credibly with engineers, devops, sre, platform, and security teams.
* confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact.
* practical experience with cloud\-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure.
* coding or scripting experience in languages such as python, go, java, javascript, bash, or similar.
* strong communication, ownership, follow\-through, and commercial judgment.

 **technical experience**

**relevant experience may include:**

* kubernetes and containerized environments
* aws, azure, or gcp
* opentelemetry
* prometheus
* docker
* apm and distributed tracing
* log analytics and telemetry pipelines
* siem or security monitoring
* infrastructure monitoring
* rum
* terraform, helm, or deployment automation
* ci/cd workflows
* application instrumentation and debugging

 **what success looks like**


the best solutions engineers at coralogix are not just strong presenters. they are technical owners.


they can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. they are hands\-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward.


they know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate.

 **why join coralogix**


observability is changing fast. data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on.


coralogix gives customers a different path: real\-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale.


as a solutions engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose coralogix.

 **compensation and benefits**

**the on\-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000\. final compensation will be based on experience, skills**, education, and work location.


our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off.


coralogix is an equal\-opportunity employer. we encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

 **cultural fit**


we’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. if you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


coralogix is an equal\-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Information Technology Architect | (Cloud Engineer)
description:
**information technology architect (cloud engineer)**

**general description and classification standards:**

the information technology architect (cloud engineer) in the enterprise data services (eds) team, within the office of technology and digital experience (tde), is responsible for architecting, engineering, and operating the cloud and database platforms that support the department of aviation’s enterprise data and ai initiatives. this hybrid role combines cloud engineering with database administration: enabling secure, scalable cloud services while administering oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed database systems, including design, development, implementation, capacity planning, monitoring for availability, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting.  



the ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud infrastructure, along with the ability to design and deliver reliable, secure, and cost\-effective data platforms that keep airport systems available 24 x 7 x 365 while enabling the airport’s analytics, automation, and ai roadmap.  



**supervision received:**

reports to the information technology director ii, enterprise data services, and works with minimal supervision, using independent judgment and initiative. makes decisions on process and procedure improvements, solutions to reduce system downtime, system maintenance to improve performance and availability, and hardware and software for databases and database application servers. provides advice on system upgrades and new technology implementation.  



**essential duties and responsibilities:**

*these are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.*

* **cloud architecture \& engineering**
	+ design, build, and maintain cloud architectures, landing zones, and reference designs for enterprise data services, aligned with eds standards, security requirements, and the enterprise data and ai roadmap.
	+ enable and manage cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and managed database and analytics services, for airport applications and data workloads.
	+ plan and execute migrations of on\-premises databases and applications to cloud platforms, including assessment, sizing, cutover, and validation.
	+ automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting, infrastructure as code, and ci/cd pipelines.
	+ monitor and optimize cloud consumption and costs, and recommend right\-sizing, reservation, and licensing strategies.
* **database administration \& operations**
	+ administer and maintain day\-to\-day operations of oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed databases, services, and software, including creating user accounts, assigning permissions and schemas, and creating tables and fields.
	+ configure and maintain database software and environments, ensuring data remains consistent, accurate, and clearly defined, and that security levels comply with division and department standards and procedures.
	+ monitor the overall health, availability, and performance of database systems, services, and data flow, and take corrective action as required to ensure reliable performance.
	+ perform installation, upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance tuning, and resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and other distributed data issues.
	+ develop and implement data models, database designs, data access code, and table maintenance code, documenting how data elements are defined and used.
* **backup, recovery \& availability**
	+ plan, schedule, and verify backup and recovery procedures, and ensure that required backups are completed.
	+ restore failed production databases and services through the disaster recovery process, and design high availability and disaster recovery solutions across on\-premises and cloud environments.
	+ act as a member of a team to ensure 24 x 7 x 365 availability of the department’s enterprise database systems and cloud services.
* **security \& compliance**
	+ plan, coordinate, and implement security measures, including access controls, encryption, and auditing, to safeguard information against accidental or unauthorized damage, modification, or disclosure.
	+ develop standards and guidelines to guide the use and acquisition of software and to protect vulnerable information.
	+ ensure cloud and database environments meet security, compliance, and operational resilience requirements, including the protection of sensitive security information (ssi), controlled unclassified information (cui), personally identifiable information (pii), and critical infrastructure data.
	+ ensure databases and software applications are patched and upgraded to current supported product versions.
* **data platform \& ai enablement**
	+ architect and support the data platforms that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and the ai roadmap, including data integration, pipelines, data warehouses, and secure environments for ai and machine learning workloads.
	+ partner with data engineers, bi engineers, and analysts to ensure data availability, performance, quality, and consistency across enterprise data services.
	+ support data governance initiatives, including metadata, lineage, data quality, and access management.
* **application \& systems support**
	+ databricks/lakehouse architecture
	+ azure architecture
	+ data modeling
	+ apis/events
	+ data governance
	+ integration patterns
	+ research and resolve problems, coordinate activities with it support staff as required, and document findings.
	+ respond to and resolve, or ensure resolution of, issues assigned by the help desk.
* **documentation \& standards**
	+ create procedures and process documentation for database and cloud standards.
	+ write technical and end\-user documentation for assigned projects, including architecture diagrams, data models, and runbooks.
	+ follow the division team handbook, policies and procedures, software standards, software development lifecycle, and change management.
* **collaboration \& continuous improvement**
	+ serve as the eds representative for the assigned area, acting as a liaison to business units and delivering customer\-focused, responsive service.
	+ analyze and recommend functional and technical process improvements, and stay current on oracle, sql server, cloud platform features, and development tools.
	support and assist with the strategic objectives and wildly important goals (wigs) of the division and the department of aviation.  
	+

**additional responsibilities**

* participate in the on\-call rotation as scheduled or requested, and respond to after\-hours emergencies as needed.
* prepare management reports related to system audit, availability, performance, and cloud costs as needed.
may perform other duties as assigned.  
* 

*the above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. coa may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.*

**knowledge skills and abilities:**

*this is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.*

* cloud architecture \& engineering: knowledge of cloud computing, networking, identity, and managed data services on platforms such as microsoft azure and aws, and the ability to design secure, scalable architectures.
* database administration: strong background in oracle and sql server administration, including sql, pl/sql, and t\-sql, performance tuning, replication, and backup and recovery.
* systems \& security: high\-level understanding of system architectures, storage, and database and cloud security practices, with working knowledge of azure environment.
* automation \& tooling: proficiency with scripting and infrastructure as code (e.g., powershell, python, terraform) and with monitoring and database management tools such as oracle enterprise manager and toad.
* project management: ability to manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently and to prioritize effectively.
* problem\-solving \& initiative: self\-starter able to use judgment and initiative to undertake activities and resolve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.
* communication \& customer service: excellent oral and written communication skills, the ability to work alone or within a team, and a customer\-focused, responsive approach when serving business units.
* vendor management: experience maintaining software licenses and managing vendor maintenance and support agreements.
availability \& flexibility: willingness to work extra hours as needed, participate in an on\-call rotation, and respond to after\-hours emergencies.  
* 

* **industry experience:** aviation, transportation, or public sector experience with knowledge of faa and tsa requirements, cybersecurity standards, and airport it ecosystems.
* **cloud architecture:** experience designing and migrating enterprise workloads and databases to microsoft azure, aws, or similar cloud platforms, including networking, identity, and landing zone design.
* **database platforms:** experience with oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed database services, including high availability, replication, backup and recovery, and performance tuning.
* **automation \& infrastructure as code:** experience with scripting (powershell, python, shell), infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform, bicep), and ci/cd and devops practices.
* **vendor \& cost management:** experience managing software licenses, vendor support agreements, and cloud consumption costs (finops).

typical office setting, with participation in an on\-call rotation and after\-hours support as scheduled or requested.

title: On Prem - AI Engineer
description:
putco is a 50\+ year usa manufacturer of truck and suv accessories (lighting, emblems, trim, oem programs). we are building a closed, on\-prem “mothership” ai stack on our erp — not a chatbot toy — so the company can measure true books, generate accurate reports, and run catalog/oem workflows without shipping proprietary data to the open internet.

we already have a first nvidia spark box running private llama (chat works). we need a full\-time owner to harden that stack, connect it deeply to macola, and lead the upgrade to a \~240b\-class multi\-gpu workstation so this becomes the operating brain of putco — not a side project.

**what you will own**

· own and harden the closed on\-prem llm environment (nvidia spark today; path to multi\-gpu \~240b\-class hardware such as 4× rtx 6000 ada — western models preferred: llama / mistral family).

· macola (erp) intelligence: read\-only sql/schema as rag, accurate report library replacing flawed legacy reports, excel→macola bom / article loaders with human\-approve write\-back only (ai never silent\-writes production data).

· mothership connectors for the full putco.com catalog \+ oem (ford, gm, nissan, mopar): attribution across wholesale / retail / web / oem; playbooks and catalog generation in sequenced waves.

· lan\-only / firewall\-locked deployment (open webui or equivalent); no leaking putco data to outside ai apis unless james locks a capped exception path.

· friday demos to james / paul with real macola questions and measurable milestones — not slideware.

· hand off cleanly from the current contractor sow; document everything so putco is not single\-threaded on one person again.

**what success looks like in 90 days**

· spark (or successor box) is the trusted macola brain: ai\_readonly \+ schema rag answering real ops/engineering questions with cited sql.

· core backlog reports shipping as excel \+ email digests james actually uses.

· bom / article loader path live under human approval.

· written hardware \+ model plan for the \~240b upgrade, priced and sequenced (b\&h / cdw class kit).

· mothership wave 0–1 underway: full data plane connected and books measurable — not a single\-sku pilot.

**must\-haves**

· hands\-on experience running open\-weight llms on nvidia hardware (ollama, vllm, tensorrt\-llm, or similar) — not only cloud saas prompt engineering.

· strong sql and willingness to live inside a mature erp schema (macola / similar manufacturing erp is a plus; you will learn ours fast).

· python (or equivalent) for loaders, rag pipelines, report automation, and light internal uis.

· security mindset: closed lan, least privilege, no “just paste it into chatgpt.”

· builder who ships weekly demos. comfortable on\-site in the des moines area with ops, engineering, and sales users.

· clear english for ceo\-level updates.

**nice\-to\-haves**

· manufacturing / automotive aftermarket / oem documentation familiarity.

· experience correcting bad legacy sql report logic.

· headless commerce / catalog feed work (woo / similar) or plm adjacency (aletiq is a separate system — do not blend without approval).

· multi\-gpu workstation build / connectx / high\-vram inference tuning.

**how we work**

· closed system first. cloud apis only under a hard monthly spend cap james sets.

· paul elwell owns digital / site execution; you own the macola \+ on\-prem intelligence layer and how it feeds the mothership.

· aletiq plm stays separate unless james expands scope in writing.
